scope: Ordinary official BF16/G2 Gemma generation and request metrics; full goal remains broader.
api: src/bin/cli/gemma4.rs::run(super::Args); src/bin/cli/gemma4/summary.rs fixed typed Record/Manifest/Collector interface. Final unpublished resource additions are header-only; no Record/Manifest/Collector layout or caller API change.

flags.submission: per-tile default; explicit batched-single-row uses Astra-retained constructor
flags.metrics_output: required exactly with summary; new bounded JSONL export once after active inference ends; failure never changes inference/session result
flags.unsupported: tools/thinking/multimodal/checkpoint inference/kernel override flags; all old profiles retain behavior

ordinary_output: Preserve established ready/token/done/error JSON event conventions and text/stats modes. Persistent generate/append/continue/reset, zero/one output, hidden stops, cancellation and authoritative before/after state. Token events are explicit requested user output, separate from routine telemetry.
source_constraints: Use existing OfficialBf16 owner/model/G2 session and its one codec/response stream; never generic Assets. No numerical/source loader/shader/ABI/default change. Preserve pending UTF8 through Continue; reset only after admission; finish decoder at stop/cancel.

metrics.record_fields: Fixed Rust types in summary.rs. Manifest attaches immutable route identity once; external capture manifest supplies exact source/build/runtime/model-content pins; unsupported provenance must be explicit. Header/footer are required for complete export.
metrics.ids: One bounded <=64-byte process/session ID with PID plus creation epoch; monotonically checked request/attempt IDs assigned before handled request validation; owner generation tracks admitted reset/replay semantics. No raw prompt/output/token arrays in routine records.
metrics.timing_units: Milliseconds in summaries, completed Report seconds multiplied by1000. Request begins at handled invocation before formatting/tokenization; ends after synchronous content publication. Declare that metadata serialization/export is outside this inner clock; matched overhead uses external submit-to-terminal event round trip including collector work. No UI/render claims from stdout.
metrics.work: Report fields only for completed Report; error snapshots are authoritative but completed phases/counts unavailable. callback_tokens counts observed callback entries and is distinct from completed Report.emitted_tokens. N<=1/nonpositive interval -> null rates. No inferred KV work from observed callbacks.
metrics.availability: Serialize explicit nulls and fixed reasons for missing ordinary GPU/host/wait/readback/pipeline/allocation/process-footprint/UI/energy data. Never substitute predicted inventory or diagnostic counters. Missing core phases on error are null, not0. Preserve stop semantics and cancellation acknowledgment scope.
metrics.collection: Disabled allocates no ring. Fixed bounded serialization and circular retained records, checked/saturating explicit overflow/drop counters, ring wrap controls. At most4KiB per summary/header/footer and <=1MiB owned retention. Telemetry failure/drop never changes inference.
metrics.export: Only after ordinary active inference ends, not per-token nor routine synchronous disk IO. create_new file avoids overwrite/symlink/FIFO hangs; explicit stdout token stream unaffected. Export_to supports failure controls. Footer gives retained/dropped/invalid/export-error counters; incomplete file/footer is not success.
metrics.collector_resources: Manifest reports actual fixed Rust Collector layout, retained Vec ring capacity and their sum as invariant logical post-construction collector_peak_bytes, with exact exclusion scope. telemetry_admitted_bytes is the existing allowance, not an additional allocation. No sampled RSS/process or temporary constructor/export peak claim.
metrics.cancellation_availability: cancel_to_terminal_ms remains null; fixed header reason signal_timestamp_not_observed; cancellation_outcome_and_state_do_not_measure_signal_to_ack_latency. Numeric invented latency is rejected.

memory: 6GiB including32MiB helper. Reserve128MiB application +4MiB stream + active telemetry allowance before owner load. Codec1GiB counted once in owner reserve. Whole load=owner.load_admitted+external; session=session.memory.admitted+owner.session_reserved+external. Checked arithmetic; distinguish admission vs sampled footprint.
first_gate: Root runs locked offline bin check CPU then Metal as soon as producer/collector interfaces compile; no model work before cheap controls. Only root starts compilers/tests/models; all lanes pause with acknowledgment during acceptance timings.
checks: Required fmt and strict CPU/Metal all-target Clippy; relevant changed CLI/collector/reader controls; exact reuse map for unchanged library/GPU/numerical/quality inputs. Explicit real CLI state/text/stop/cancel/error parity before original3warm+10paired overhead and independent confirmation. Keep source/binary/model/runtime receipts; no gate/tolerance/N rescue.
review: One combined Astra with diff/invariants/all checks and evidence before commit/push; default/adoption/performance qualification only to proved scope.

interface_updates.invariant: Only replace most-recent matching request/attempt/session; no new record or count drift. Correct terminal metadata output failure to OutputError without losing successful completed core fields. Inference unchanged by telemetry. All owners informed.

Attach full numerical logical memory once, including positional/PLE and metadata; check component sum and whole-admission residual, not additive duplicate totals. owner_generation stays1 for immutable owner lifetime.
OutputError correction may set replay_required false->true or retain true; cannot clear it or mutate other payload/counters.

interface_updates.method: Work logical prompt and overflow reporting
interface_updates.invariant: prompt_tokens is RequestAdmission.history_after_input_tokens, including reused history for Append/Continue. replayed_rows counts completed prefill overlapping prior committed positions; never infer from callbacks. Collector::note_counter_overflow marks unassignable attempt IDs before refusal and state mutation.

qualification_delta: Source2 84-case conformance and its strict reader stay at original persistent paths. Final header-only delta gets affected checks, fresh source/binary pins, both-policy real header/export smoke and original frozen overhead; unchanged numerical/quality/state evidence is reused only through relevant-input comparison.
